mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id AS reportId, r.sample_id AS sampleId, gs.sample_no AS sampleNo, r.title, r.variant_count AS variantCount, r.pathogenic_count AS pathogenicCount, r.status, '' AS createdByName, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM genomic_reports r JOIN genomic_samples gs ON gs.sample_id = r.sample_id WHERE 1=1 AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.sample_id = #{sampleId} ORDER BY r.report_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.report_id AS reportId, r.tenant_id AS tenantId, r.sample_id AS sampleId, gs.sample_no AS sampleNo, r.title, r.summary, r.variant_count AS variantCount, r.pathogenic_count AS pathogenicCount, r.status, r.created_by AS createdBy, '' AS createdByName, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM genomic_reports r JOIN genomic_samples gs ON gs.sample_id = r.sample_id WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO genomic_reports (tenant_id, sample_id, title, summary, variant_count, pathogenic_count, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{sampleId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{variantCount}, #{pathogenicCount}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE genomic_reports SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
